brief: Reconstruct the user-supplied Astraeus Heavy Lander concept as a detailed multipart printable display model
intended_use: 480 mm display model from user-supplied concept, multipart FDM

print.height_limit_note: 250 mm conservative validation limit; only XY bed was specified by user

reference: User-provided Astraeus Heavy Lander concept sheet, 3 October 2026
assumptions: Confirmed by user: 480 mm model, 0.4 mm FDM nozzle, 256 mm bed, Bambu X2D. Suggested 0.12-0.16 mm layers.
Silhouette takes precedence over inconsistent upper-canard span annotation
Deployed legs are static; fins/canards separate; glue optional after test fitting
Surface details enlarged where needed for printing
